correctness.rationale: Two independent predicates were checked on all 65,536 masks for both graphs. The standalone code verifies face and facet vectors, 639/543 disjoint Morse pairs and all 4,960/4,224 incidence orientations, and visits every node by a topological sort. Precisely one vertex and 57/105 three-cells remain. Forman discrete Morse theory therefore gives the claimed integral wedges, not merely field homology.

value.rationale: The two graphs are the canonical nonisomorphic strongly regular pair with shared parameters (16,6,2,2); parameter 2 is the first higher-independence complex and is equivalent to a natural forbidden-P3 vertex-set system. The complete integral homotopy computation for both nonpure complexes provides a meaningful cospectral distinguishing invariant, and the sphere-count ordering reverses their known ordinary-independence ordering. This is motivated structural information, not an arbitrary induced subset or a mere finite field rank.
